d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne nepal ke pradhanmantri ke sath dvipakshiy varta men bharat aur nepal ke bich sahyog evan sajhedari ko aur majbut banane par diya jor, vibhinn kshetron men samjhauta gyapnon par hastakshar, vahin gati shakti portal ka bhi kiya avlokna. mukhyamantri hemant soren ranchi men aayojit prashikshit yuvaon ke samman samaroh men hue shamil, yuvaon ke bich niyukti patron ka kiya vitran, mukhyamantri ne yuvaon ke kaushal vikas aur unke samagr vikas par diya bala. kendriy mantri annapurna devi ne rajy sarkar par chhatrahiton ki andekhi ka lagaya aarop, kodarma men kaha ki…
